_conforms_to.spec: Anthropic MCP tool-schema spec. O-Cloud surface per O-RAN.WG6.O2IMS-Interface.
_conforms_to.spec_section: MCP tools object; O2 IMS Inventory, Alarms, and ProvisioningRequest endpoints
_conforms_to.schema_role: Declares the tool surface for mcp-ocloud, the FastMCP server exposing O2 IMS Inventory, Alarms, Cluster, and gated apply tools. Consumed by the Platform Agent for inventory context AND by the Remediation Router for the apply step.

server_role: O-Cloud Manager facade for the harness (read-mostly, one gated write)

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Returns O2 IMS Inventory entries for clusters, nodes, and node-level resources visible to the O-Cloud Manager. Read-only.

tools.name: get_alarms
tools.description: Returns O2 IMS Alarms current set for a cluster. Read-only.

tools.name: get_cluster_state
tools.description: Returns aggregated cluster state (operator pool rollout status, MachineConfig pool degradation, KMM module reconciliation state). Used by the Router to verify pre-conditions before proposing a remediation.

tools.name: apply_remediation
tools.description: Gated write. Submits a RemediationProposal as an O2 IMS ProvisioningRequest. RECEIVING TOOL MUST verify guardrails.yaml co_authorization commit_phase has completed AND humanApprovalStatus is approved before invoking.
